Assistant (1.1s): Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. We record this call. Am I speaking with Mr Ortiz?

User (2.1s): Yes, this is Samuel Ortiz.

Assistant (3.4s): Thank you. Before we continue, I need to ask you two short security questions. What is your date of birth?

User (4.2s): the fifth of December nineteen seventy-five.

Assistant (7.0s): Thank you. What is the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (8.6s): seven zero nine three.

Assistant (13.6s): Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the Freya Bank collections team about a late payment. your personal loan has a past-due amount of 540.00, which is 5 days late. Can you make this payment today?

User (14.8s): I cannot pay that today. I can pay it the week after next.

Assistant (17.3s): I understand. What is the exact day you have in mind, Mr Ortiz?

User (18.8s): Monday the twenty-sixth.

Assistant (21.0s): Monday 26 October 2026 is not a business day, Mr Ortiz. Can you pay 540.00 on the next business day, Tuesday 27 October 2026?

User (23.0s): Yes, I can do that.

Assistant (25.8s): To confirm: you will pay 540.00 for the personal loan on Tuesday 27 October 2026. Do you confirm?

User (27.0s): Yes, I confirm.

Assistant (30.0s): Thank you, one moment please.

Assistant (36.5s): Thank you. Your promise of 540.00 for the personal loan on Tuesday 27 October 2026 is recorded. You will receive a text message confirming this promise. Thank you for your time, goodbye.
